functions.name: INSTRUMENT
functions.description: Build the opaque instrument token the polymorphic verbs price: one underlier grammar across FX/metal/equity/commodity/crypto + a product family + a named key/value terms range.

parameters.name: underlier
parameters.description: Underlier: EURUSD, XAUUSD, AAPL@XNAS:USD, BRENT@:USD, BTC/USD[:inverse|:linear].

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Product family: VANILLA, STRATEGY (or RISK_REVERSAL/STRADDLE/STRANGLE/SEAGULL), BARRIER, WINDOWBARRIER, DIGITAL, TOUCH, VARSWAP, VOLSWAP, ASIAN, FORWARDSTART, CLIQUET, QUANTO, TARF, ACCUMULATOR, LOOKBACK, AMERICAN, BASKET, FORWARD, SWAP, NDF, PERPETUAL, FUTUREOPTION.

parameters.name: terms
parameters.description: 2-column key/value terms range; keys mirror the family's parameters (legs/correlations rows repeat).

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y (or a ("tenor", ...) term).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Notional in the base/asset leg (or a ("notional", ...) term; default 1).

functions.name: PRICE
functions.description: Price one structure: the vanilla positional mid premium, or the full family spill for a CELNET.INSTRUMENT token (any product, any asset class).

parameters.name: pairOrInstrument
parameters.description: Currency pair (e.g. EURUSD) or a CELNET.INSTRUMENT token.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y (positional form only).

parameters.name: strikeOrDelta
parameters.description: Absolute strike (1.12) or delta (25dP, ATM) (positional form only).

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for call, P for put (positional form only).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency (positional form only).

functions.name: GREEKS
functions.description: The 13-Greek vector spill [name, value] with a convention footer; accepts the legacy vanilla positional form or a CELNET.INSTRUMENT token.

parameters.name: pairOrInstrument
parameters.description: Currency pair (e.g. EURUSD) or a CELNET.INSTRUMENT token.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y (positional form only).

parameters.name: strikeOrDelta
parameters.description: Absolute strike (1.12) or delta (25dP, ATM) (positional form only).

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for call, P for put (positional form only).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency (positional form only).

functions.name: RATES
functions.description: Price an OIS against a self-discounting curve via the live price_rates engine RPC; spills [pv, par_rate, pv01, dv01] then the key-rate DV01 ladder (one kr_dv01[<tenor>Y] row per curve pillar).

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: 2-column [tenorYears, parRate] curve range; one row per OIS pillar, strictly increasing tenor.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Curve reference (spot-anchor) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: OIS tenor in whole years (e.g. 5 or 5Y).

parameters.name: fixedRate
parameters.description: Fixed-leg rate as a decimal (0.041 = 4.10%).

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: PAY_FIXED (payer) or RECEIVE_FIXED (receiver).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Positive notional in the curve currency.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO-4217 curve currency (defaults to USD).

functions.name: BOND
functions.description: Price a fixed-coupon cash bond off a self-discounting curve via the live price_rates engine RPC (the RatesInstrument.bond arm); spills [dirty_price, ytm, dv01] (the fields the bond price response carries: dirty price, yield to maturity, yield DV01).

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: 2-column [tenorYears, parRate] discount-curve range; one row per OIS pillar, strictly increasing tenor.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Curve reference (settlement / spot-anchor) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: maturity
parameters.description: Bond maturity (final-redemption) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD; must be after referenceDate.

parameters.name: couponRate
parameters.description: Annual coupon rate as a decimal (0.06 = 6%); 0 for a zero-coupon bond.

parameters.name: redemption
parameters.description: Optional par redemption / face value (defaults to 100).

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Optional coupon frequency: ANNUAL, SEMI_ANNUAL (default) or QUARTERLY.

parameters.name: dayCount
parameters.description: Optional accrual day-count: ACT_360, ACT_365_FIXED or THIRTY_360_BOND_BASIS (default).

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Optional position direction: LONG (default, +PV) or SHORT (-PV).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO-4217 curve currency (defaults to USD).

functions.name: IRS
functions.description: Price a spot-starting vanilla fixed-vs-float interest-rate swap off a self-discounting curve via the live price_rates engine RPC (the RatesInstrument.irs arm); spills [pv, par_rate, pv01, dv01] then the key-rate DV01 ladder (one kr_dv01[<tenor>Y] row per curve pillar).

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: 2-column [tenorYears, parRate] curve range; one row per OIS pillar, strictly increasing tenor.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Curve reference (spot-anchor) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Swap tenor in whole years (e.g. 5 or 5Y).

parameters.name: fixedRate
parameters.description: Fixed-leg rate as a decimal (0.041 = 4.10%).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Positive notional in the curve currency.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Optional direction: PAY_FIXED (payer, default) or RECEIVE_FIXED (receiver).

parameters.name: fixedFrequency
parameters.description: Optional fixed-leg frequency: ANNUAL, SEMI_ANNUAL (default) or QUARTERLY.

parameters.name: fixedDayCount
parameters.description: Optional fixed-leg day-count: ACT_360 (default) or ACT_365_FIXED.

parameters.name: floatFrequency
parameters.description: Optional float-leg frequency: ANNUAL, SEMI_ANNUAL or QUARTERLY (default).

parameters.name: floatDayCount
parameters.description: Optional float-leg day-count: ACT_360 (default) or ACT_365_FIXED.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO-4217 curve currency (defaults to USD).

functions.name: FRA
functions.description: Price a forward rate agreement off a self-discounting curve via the live price_rates engine RPC (the RatesInstrument.fra arm); the accrual window is quoted in whole months from spot (the 3x6 FRA convention). Spills [pv, par_rate, pv01, dv01] then the key-rate DV01 ladder (one kr_dv01[<tenor>Y] row per curve pillar).

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: 2-column [tenorYears, parRate] curve range; one row per OIS pillar, strictly increasing tenor.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Curve reference (spot-anchor) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: startMonths
parameters.description: Window start (fixing) tenor in whole months from spot (e.g. 3 or 3M).

parameters.name: endMonths
parameters.description: Window end (maturity) tenor in whole months from spot (e.g. 6 or 6M); must be after startMonths.

parameters.name: fixedRate
parameters.description: Contractual fixed rate as a decimal (0.033 = 3.30%).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Positive notional in the curve currency.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Optional direction: PAY_FIXED (payer, default) or RECEIVE_FIXED (receiver).

parameters.name: accrualBasis
parameters.description: Optional accrual day-count: ACT_360 (default), ACT_365_FIXED or THIRTY_360_BOND_BASIS.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO-4217 curve currency (defaults to USD).

functions.name: RATESRFQ
functions.description: Request a tradeable two-way fixed-income RFQ off a self-discounting curve via the live request_rates_quote engine RPC (the FI twin of CELNET.RFQ); a single two-way maker quote struck around the side-independent fair level. Spills a labelled 10x2 matrix: [bid, offer, mid, notional, quote_id, valid_until] then the taker-side risk [pv, par_rate, pv01, dv01].

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: 2-column [tenorYears, parRate] curve range; one row per OIS pillar, strictly increasing tenor.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Curve reference (spot-anchor) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Instrument tenor in whole years (e.g. 5 or 5Y).

parameters.name: fixedRate
parameters.description: Fixed-leg rate as a decimal (0.041 = 4.10%).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Positive RFQ size in the curve currency.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Optional taker side: BUY (pay fixed), SELL (receive fixed) or TWO_WAY (default).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO-4217 curve currency (defaults to USD).

parameters.name: instrument
parameters.description: Optional instrument arm: OIS (default) or IRS (a spot-starting vanilla swap).

functions.name: RATESRISK
functions.description: Net a linear-rates OIS book against one shared curve via the live aggregate_rates_risk engine RPC; spills one server-netted node per settlement currency: [ccy, net_pv, net_pv01, net_dv01] then the key-rate DV01 ladder (one kr_dv01[<tenor>Y] column per curve pillar).

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: 2-column [tenorYears, parRate] curve range; one row per OIS pillar, strictly increasing tenor (the shared market every position prices against).

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Curve reference (spot-anchor) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: positions
parameters.description: Row-per-position range [tenorYears, fixedRate, direction, notional, entity?, book?]; one OIS per row (direction PAY_FIXED/RECEIVE_FIXED carries the sign).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO-4217 curve currency (defaults to USD).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Optional pre-rollup filter: a comma-separated list of ENTITY:<n>, BOOK:<n>, CCY:<xxx> (omit for the whole book).

functions.name: XVA
functions.description: Price the all-in CVA / DVA / FVA of a netting set of FX vanilla options via the live price_xva engine RPC (PricingService.PriceXva); spills [cva, dva, fva, total_adjustment] (total = cva - dva + fva) then a provenance footer. The four scalars are the whole wire result - the simulated exposure profile is a server-internal and is never shown.

parameters.name: trades
parameters.description: Row-per-trade netting-set range [callPut, strike, expiryYears, vol, notional]; one FX vanilla per row (callPut C/P; notional SIGNED so the set nets long against short).

parameters.name: spot0
parameters.description: Initial spot S0 (quote per 1 unit of base); > 0.

parameters.name: sigma
parameters.description: Exposure-model annualised volatility as a decimal (0.1 = 10%); >= 0.

parameters.name: rDom
parameters.description: Continuously-compounded domestic (quote) rate, a decimal.

parameters.name: rFor
parameters.description: Continuously-compounded foreign (base) rate, a decimal.

parameters.name: counterparty
parameters.description: Counterparty survival curve: a flat hazard lambda (single cell) or a 2-column [pillarYears, hazard] range (strictly increasing).

parameters.name: own
parameters.description: Own survival curve: a flat hazard lambda (single cell) or a 2-column [pillarYears, hazard] range (strictly increasing).

parameters.name: lgdCounterparty
parameters.description: Counterparty loss-given-default, a decimal in [0, 1].

parameters.name: lgdOwn
parameters.description: Own loss-given-default, a decimal in [0, 1].

parameters.name: fundingSpread
parameters.description: Funding spread over risk-free, an absolute decimal (0.008 = 80bp).

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: Optional Monte-Carlo exposure paths (whole number >= 1; default 4096).

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Optional exposure-RNG seed (whole number >= 0; default 1); a fixed seed reproduces the estimate.

parameters.name: exposureSteps
parameters.description: Optional exposure time buckets to the set horizon (whole number >= 1; default 16).

functions.name: RATESBOOK
functions.description: List the desk's standing linear-rates BOOK (the server-owned OIS position ledger) via the live list_rates_positions engine RPC; resolves each numeric (entity, book) key to its registry NAME (list_entities/list_books, falling back to #<key>) and spills [position_id, entity, book, instrument, fixed_rate, notional, direction] per booked OIS.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Optional pre-list filter: a comma-separated list of ENTITY:<n>, BOOK:<n> (omit for the whole entitled book).

functions.name: INSTRUMENTS
functions.description: List the instrument reference-data REGISTRY (definitions the curve/pricing paths resolve against) via the live list_instruments engine RPC, or one definition by id via get_instrument; spills [instrument_id, name, family, currency, description, external_ids, terms] per definition.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Optional registry instrument id (e.g. usd-sofr-irs-10y); omit to list the whole roster.

functions.name: CURVE
functions.description: Bootstrap a single-currency discount curve from its market pillars via the live build_curve engine RPC; spills a header then [pillar, time_years, discount_factor, zero_rate] per bootstrapped pillar.

parameters.name: pillars
parameters.description: 2-column [pillar, quote] range; each pillar is a registry instrument id OR a maturity date (Excel date / YYYY-MM-DD), the quote is the observed rate as a decimal.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Curve reference (spot-anchor) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO-4217 curve currency (defaults to USD).

functions.name: GETCURVE
functions.description: Read a marked or live-bootstrapped discount curve via the live get_curve engine RPC (SurfaceService.GetCurve); spills the queried points [tenor_years, discount_factor, zero_rate], the echoed par pillars, then a version/currency footer.

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: 2-column [tenorYears, parRate] curve range; one row per OIS pillar, strictly increasing tenor.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Curve reference (spot-anchor) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: pinnedVersion
parameters.description: Optional MarkCurve version to read from the store (omit to bootstrap the curve live).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO-4217 curve currency (defaults to USD).

functions.name: MARKCURVE
functions.description: Mark (persist) a discount curve under a fresh server-assigned version via the live mark_curve engine RPC (SurfaceService.MarkCurve — the FI analogue of MARKSURFACE); spills the bootstrapped points [tenor_years, discount_factor, zero_rate], the echoed par pillars, then a version/currency footer carrying the assigned pinned version (a later CELNET.GETCURVE pins it). Commits a write on evaluation.

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: 2-column [tenorYears, parRate] curve range; one row per OIS pillar, strictly increasing tenor.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Curve reference (spot-anchor) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO-4217 curve currency (defaults to USD).

functions.name: SURFACE
functions.description: The marked smile for a (pair, tenor) as a delta x vol grid with an arb + convention footer.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional smile model to surface: VV, SABR, SVI, SSVI.

functions.name: MARKSURFACE
functions.description: Calibrate & mark a surface under a chosen model (VV/SABR/SVI/SSVI); spills the calibrated smile + version footer.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Smile model: VV (market hedge), SABR, SVI or SSVI.

parameters.name: atmVol
parameters.description: At-the-money volatility (absolute, e.g. 0.102).

parameters.name: rr25
parameters.description: 25-delta risk reversal (call vol - put vol).

parameters.name: bf25
parameters.description: 25-delta butterfly (broker fly).

parameters.name: rr10
parameters.description: Optional 10-delta risk reversal (with bf10 for a 5-point smile).

parameters.name: bf10
parameters.description: Optional 10-delta butterfly.

functions.name: RFQ
functions.description: RFQ for a structure: spill [bid, offer, quoteId, validUntil] + convention footer; accepts the legacy vanilla positional form or a CELNET.INSTRUMENT token. Pass TRUE (or PANEL) as the trailing panel flag to spill the ranked multi-dealer panel (one row per LP with BEST markers) instead.

parameters.name: pairOrInstrument
parameters.description: Currency pair (e.g. EURUSD) or a CELNET.INSTRUMENT token.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y (positional form only).

parameters.name: strikeOrDelta
parameters.description: Absolute strike (1.12) or delta (25dP, ATM) (positional form only).

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for call, P for put (positional form only).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency (positional form only).

parameters.name: panel
parameters.description: Optional: TRUE or PANEL for the ranked multi-dealer panel spill (lp_id, bid, offer, valid_until, BEST markers).

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for call, P for put (positional form only).

parameters.name: notional

functions.name: SERIES
functions.description: Stream a live market observable trend (ATM/SPOT/RR/BF/FWD), multiplexed, coalesced, stale-aware.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: observable
parameters.description: Observable: ATM, SPOT, RR, BF or FWD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Pillar tenor for ATM/RR/BF/FWD, e.g. 1Y (omit for SPOT).

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: Delta wing for RR/BF, e.g. 0.25 (omit otherwise).

functions.name: RATESSERIES

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: 2-column [tenorYears, parRate] curve range; one row per OIS pillar, strictly increasing tenor.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Curve reference (spot-anchor) date: an Excel date cell or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: OIS tenor in whole years (e.g. 5 or 5Y).

parameters.name: fixedRate
parameters.description: Fixed-leg rate as a decimal (0.041 = 4.10%).

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: PAY_FIXED (payer) or RECEIVE_FIXED (receiver).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Positive notional in the curve currency.

parameters.name: observable
parameters.description: Measure to stream: PV (default), PAR, PV01 or DV01.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO-4217 curve currency (defaults to USD).

functions.name: MARK
functions.description: Stage a manual vol/mark contribution (two-phase, idempotent; commits via the task pane).

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: pillar
parameters.description: Delta pillar (ATM, 25dP, 10dC).

parameters.name: vol
parameters.description: Absolute volatility, e.g. 0.102.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional smile model the commit calibrates under: VV, SABR, SVI, SSVI.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Optional contribution comment.

functions.name: RISK
functions.description: Server-side hierarchical risk aggregate over the org cube: spill the rolled-up node tree in a reporting numeraire.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Roll-up dimension: FIRM, TRADER, BOOK, DESK, PAIR, LOCATION or ENTITY.

parameters.name: numeraire
parameters.description: Reporting currency, e.g. USD (3-letter code).

parameters.name: rates
parameters.description: Optional [ccy, rate] rows: numeraire units per 1 unit of ccy at spot.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Optional scope DIM:value (e.g. DESK:99) to narrow before the group-by.

functions.name: POSITIONS
functions.description: List the entitled open positions the cube aggregates (the desk's book) with org placement + attribution.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Optional scope DIM:value (e.g. BOOK:7) to narrow the listing (omit for all).

functions.name: LIMITS
functions.description: Limit-tree utilization + RAG for a scope node, computed server-side against the node's aggregated exposure.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Scope DIM:value (e.g. DESK:99) or FIRM for the firm apex.

parameters.name: numeraire
parameters.description: Reporting currency the exposures are expressed in, e.g. USD.

parameters.name: rates
parameters.description: Optional [ccy, rate] rows: numeraire units per 1 unit of ccy at spot.

functions.name: STATUS
functions.description: Live server observability: connection state, drain-side price latency (p50/p99/p99.9), celnet-fanout ring conflation drops, and surface-version / correlation provenance echo from the latest server heartbeat.
